title: KAUST Rising Stars in AI Symposium 2027
institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

compensation.value: Travel and accommodation covered for selected speakers
compensation.evidence_quote: Travel and accommodation expenses will be covered for all selected speakers.

about: Call for speakers for the KAUST Rising Stars in AI Symposium, 1-3 February 2027 in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia, aimed at PhD students, postdocs and early-career faculty in AI. Speaker applications close 15 November 2026; notifications late November.
requirements: PhD students, postdocs and early-career faculty who have recently made substantial contributions to AI
In-person attendance only (1-3 February 2027, Building 19, Thuwal)
Separate poster call for KAUST and Saudi-based researchers; external poster presenters cover their own travel

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD students, postdocs and early-career faculty who have recently made substantial contributions to AI" -> "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Speakers selected on research merit" -> "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."

card_alt: Card for the KAUST Rising Stars in AI Symposium 2027, a call for speakers from King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia, with applications closing 15 Nov 2026. The photo shows the Riyadh skyline at dusk with the Kingdom Centre tower lit in blue.
